environment.description: Node.js 16.x Express application deployed on Kubernetes (EKS 1.24) with default namespace. Container runs as root with hostPath volume mount at /var/log mapping to host /var/log/containers. No PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforced. Ingress is a basic nginx-ingress controller with default configuration (no header sanitization). Node.js HTTP parser allows header values containing \r\n in older versions when set via res.setHeader().
